Street budgetary resources 917,745 + 67,681 + 137,927 + 245,500 + 641,690 = 2,010,543 vs p4 2,033,653 (23,110); Debt Service 1,138,243 + 15,481 + 396,373 + 44,607 = 1,594,704 vs p4 2,159,971 (565,267). 23,110 + 565,267 = 588,377 = the gap. Exhibit L prints every Debt Service Fund outflow as one budgetary line 'Other Financing Uses' 2,122,285 (in detail as other financing), while p4 prints Debt Service Total Expenditures 2,252,861 (Capital Outlay 108,283 + Lease Payments 10,937 + Bond Payments 2,133,641). 1,867 + 2,252,861 - 1 = 2,254,727 = the gap. The Debt Service GAAP rows' money is already inside the budgetary 'Other Financing Uses' line (2,122,285 cannot be split into them), so adding them would double count. No fix.

Exhibit E p4 Debt Service Fund column prints Bond Proceeds 18,651, Loan Proceeds 56,350, Capitalized Lease Proceeds 40,533 = 115,534 (= JSON debt_proceeds; no other column prints proceeds).
